text: Writing on behalf of my stepdaughter, who's 11. She's had a temperature since yesterday and it's 37.8 right now. Earlier this evening I noticed small purple-red dots on her arms and chest, some of them like little bruises. I pressed the side of a clear glass against them and they didn't fade at all, they stayed the same colour. Her breathing has also changed over the last half hour or so. She's breathing much faster than normal, and when she breathes in you can see the skin sucking in under her ribs. Every so often there's a little grunt on the out breath. I'm writing this out calmly so I get the details right, but I'd like to know what we should be doing right now.
